blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “The best of you is the one who learns the Qur'an and teaches it.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ اْلاَسْلَمِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ وَتَعَلَّمَهُ وَعَمِلَ بِهِ أُلْبِسَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَاجاً مِنْ نُورٍ ضَوْؤُهُ مِثْلُ ضَوْءِ الشَّمْسِ وَيُكْسَي وَالِدَيْهِ حُلَّتَانِ لَا يَقُومُ بِهِمَا الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولَانِ بِمَا كُسِينَا هذَا؟ فَيُقَالُ بِأَخْذِ وَلَدِكُمَا الْقُرْآنَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: هذا حديث صحيح علي شرط مسلم ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:١ /٥٦٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Buraidah Aslami (RA) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever recites the Qur'an, learns it and acts upon it, on the Day of Judgement a crown made of light will be placed on him, its light will be like that of the sun; his parents will be clothed in two garments to which the whole world cannot compare; they will ask, ‘For what reason are we being clothed in these garments?’ It will be replied, ‘In return for your having taught the Qur'an to your child!’”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِنِ الْجُهَنِيِّ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَمِلَ بِمَا فِيهِ أُلْبِسَ وَالِدَاهُ تَاجاً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ضَوْءُهُ أَحْسَنُ مِنْ ضَوْءِ الشَّمْسِ فِي بُيُوتِ الدُّنْيَا لَوْ كَانَتْ فِيكُمْ فَمَاظَنُّكُمْ بِالَّذِي عَمِلَ بِهذَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه أبوداود باب في ثواب قراءة القرآن رقم: ١٤٥٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “The parents of one who learns the Qur'an and acts upon it will be crowned on the Day of Qiyamah with a crown more radiant than the sun”, if that sun were inside your houses (the crown will give more light than it would shine); in that case, what do you think of the one who does deeds according to the Qur'an? “If this is the reward for the parents themselves, then for the one who does the deeds, far more than this
